title: raw_buf + incremental UTF-8 decode in subscribe_events: handles codepoints split across HTTP chunks
description: subscribe_events accumulates raw bytes into raw_buf before UTF-8 decoding. When std::str::from_utf8 fails, it uses Utf8Error::valid_up_to() to extract the valid prefix and leave the incomplete multi-byte tail in raw_buf for the next chunk. Without this, a 3-byte UTF-8 codepoint that arrives as [0xE2, 0x82] then [0xAC] would cause a spurious parse error or stream termination. A contributor might suggest calling String::from_utf8_lossy (which replaces the tail with U+FFFD) or decoding per-chunk directly. Either alternative would corrupt event data containing non-ASCII characters at chunk boundaries. The two-buffer approach is required for correctness.
